title: Outbound SDR Research and Personalisation Agent
summary: An agent that researches target accounts from public sources, writes cited account briefs and draft first lines for SDRs, and syncs to your CRM, with a person approving every message.

seo.title: Outbound SDR Research and Personalisation Agent | VipraTech
seo.description: AI agent that researches B2B accounts from public sources, writes cited briefs and draft first lines for SDRs, and syncs to HubSpot or Salesforce.

problem.intro: Good outbound starts with research: what the company does, what changed recently, who owns the problem and why now. SDRs spend much of their day on that research, or skip it and send generic messages that buyers ignore. AI writing tools help with wording but often invent facts that damage credibility.

pain_points.title: Research takes too long
pain_points.detail: Reading the website, job posts, news and product pages for each account leaves little time for actual outreach.

pain_points.title: Generic messages
pain_points.detail: Without real context, sequences fall back on templates that sound like everyone else's.

pain_points.title: Invented facts
pain_points.detail: AI-written lines can mention funding, hires or launches that never happened, which ends the conversation.

pain_points.title: Research lost after the email
pain_points.detail: Notes stay in an SDR's head or a browser tab, not in the CRM where the account executive needs them.

solution.overview: We build a research agent that works through your target account list. For each account it reads permitted public sources: company website, product and pricing pages, careers pages, press releases, news and public filings where relevant. It checks fit against your ideal customer profile, identifies likely triggers such as a new product line, hiring for a role your product supports or a market expansion, and suggests relevant personas. It writes a short account brief in which every claim links to its source, and drafts first lines and talking points in your tone. SDRs review, edit and approve before anything is sent. Briefs and sources are saved to the CRM account record.
capabilities: Account research from permitted public sources such as websites, careers pages and news
Ideal customer profile fit scoring with reasons
Trigger detection such as relevant hiring, launches or expansion
Account briefs in which every claim links to a source
Draft first lines and talking points in your tone, for SDR approval
CRM sync of briefs, sources and fit scores

workflow.title: Load the target list
workflow.detail: Accounts come from your CRM, a list upload or an enrichment tool you already licence.

workflow.title: Research each account
workflow.detail: The agent reads permitted public sources and records each fact with its source link.

workflow.title: Score fit and triggers
workflow.detail: It scores fit against your ideal customer profile and notes any relevant triggers.

workflow.title: Draft the brief and lines
workflow.detail: It writes a cited account brief and draft first lines for the chosen persona.

workflow.title: SDR review
workflow.detail: The SDR checks facts, edits the message and approves or rejects it.

workflow.title: Sync and sequence
workflow.detail: Approved messages go into your sequencing tool, and the brief is saved to the CRM.

inputs: Ideal customer profile and persona definitions
outputs: Draft first lines and talking points
CRM records updated with briefs and sources
human_in_the_loop: SDRs check every fact and approve every message before it enters a sequence. The agent never sends email or social messages on its own.
integrations: CRM such as HubSpot or Salesforce
Sequencing tools such as Outreach, Salesloft, Apollo or Lemlist
Your website and product documentation as messaging sources
guardrails: Every claim in a brief must link to a source; unsupported claims are removed
Only permitted sources fetched, respecting site terms and robots rules
Suppression and do-not-contact lists checked before drafting
No inferences about protected personal characteristics
compliance_notes: Outreach to EU contacts needs a lawful basis and opt-out handling under GDPR and ePrivacy rules; recorded sources support that assessment.
For Indian contacts, personal data handling follows DPDP Act 2023 principles, and calls or SMS follow TRAI rules.

pilot.scope: One segment of a few hundred target accounts, with two or three SDRs reviewing briefs and drafts.

what_we_measure.how: SDRs mark each brief claim as correct, wrong or unsupported against its source.
Share of drafts approved with no or minor edits.
SDR time per account with and without the agent, on a sample.
Replies from agent-assisted sequences compared with existing sequences, reviewed by the SDR manager.

faqs.q: Will it invent facts about prospects?
faqs.a: It is built to avoid that. Every claim must link to a source, unsupported claims are removed, and SDRs check facts before approving.
No. It uses permitted public sources and data providers you already licence, within their terms.
No. It drafts; your SDRs approve and send through your existing sequencing tool.
Yes. We configure it with your tone guide and examples of messages your team likes, and SDR edits help refine the drafts over time.
